scope: Fix review findings 1 and 2. Keep finding 3 unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Input arriving during interruption replay stays behind held input until replay drains.
Buffered input goes directly to accepted-input handling without replay metadata or repeated admission.
Admission fixes the destination context under the lifecycle lock; later prompt replacement cannot relabel admitted input.
Cancellation or a replacement turn prevents remaining stale replay.
Unclear-input expiry waits for replay and is cancelled by a usable final transcript.
A valid playback receipt cannot expire while message completion waits for replay.
VAD-end inference does not block queued STT-end or resumed VAD-start.
EOS audio, transcript and VAD state updates remain ordered; stale inference cannot complete a newer turn.
Prediction cancellation and shutdown retain resource ownership.
risks: Reentrant replay can deadlock or buffer itself if admission and dispatch are not separated.
Asynchronous inference can race resumed speech or provider shutdown.
Existing timer and audio-before-transcript behavior must remain unchanged.
cleanup: Turn update and replay draining use linear control flow without a deferred callback.
Input admission and accepted-input delivery are separate. Packets carry no replay marker.
Transcript and user-input transitions remain lifecycle-owned and run after admission.
Admission returns the admitted transcript packet rather than a boolean; downstream delivery uses its captured context.
Unclear-input expiry uses the existing held-packet queue, without separate pending state.
Audio snapshot logic stays inline at VAD-end; tests observe asynchronous inference behavior.
verification_commands: CI=true just agent-finalize "$(git diff --name-only -- api/assistant-api/internal/adapters api/assistant-api/internal/end_of_speech/internal/pipecat api/assistant-api/internal/type | paste -sd, -)"

admission_refactor.non_goals: No changes to EOS inference, transport controls, public protobufs, or finding 3.
risks: Buffered input must not re-enter admission or lose context validation.
Moving timer updates after admission must preserve filler, final-transcript, and unclear-input behavior.
User input without a context must retain the active context when buffered.

verification.eos_worker_checks: Provider race suite, 20 focused race repetitions, and blocked-inference benchmark passed.
verification.limitations: No live provider or carrier call was exercised. Existing native-linker warnings were nonfatal.

independent_review.replay: Approved after fixing the admitted-packet context race. No unresolved major findings. Current, previous, and blank context regression cases passed 20 times under the race detector.
independent_review.eos: No findings in the cleaned production and test diff.

publication: Included with the implementation commit on rfc/interruption-lifecycle. Unrelated worktree changes excluded.
